name: Burkinabe To
description: Tô, a stiff millet or corn porridge, is widely considered Burkina Faso's national dish, traditionally torn by hand and dipped into sauce.
steps_detailed: Whisk the cornmeal into 1.25 cups boiling water.

name: Burkinabe Riz Gras
description: Riz gras, meaning 'fat rice', a rich tomato-and-meat rice dish, a common Burkinabe one-pot meal shared across much of West Africa.

Add the tomatoes and carrot, and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the rice and 1.25 cups water, cover, and simmer 18-20 minutes until tender.

name: Burkinabe Babenda
description: Babenda, a leafy green sauce built on real ground peanuts and okra, a beloved Burkinabe dish, traditionally served over tô.

description: Poulet bicyclette, meaning 'bicycle chicken' for how free-range village chickens are transported to market by bike, is a beloved Burkinabe dish prized for its firmer, more flavorful meat.

Thread onto skewers and grill, turning, 8-10 minutes, until charred and cooked through.
